menu.noPermission: You don't have permission to open the store menu.
menu.title: 🛍️ Store
menu.description:
Use the buttons below to manage the module.

• **Post store** publishes a panel with a "See products" button. The list always opens up to date, so there is no need to post again when a product changes.
• Create or edit products in the web panel under **Store**.
menu.off: Turn on the Store module in the web panel to use this command.

panel.posted: The store panel was posted in this channel.
panel.description:
Click **See products** to see the catalog with current prices and buy.
Once the payment is approved, delivery is automatic.
